newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-TREZEGUET SIGNS FIRST PRO CONTRACT WITH MONACO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TREZEGUET SIGNS FIRST PRO CONTRACT WITH MONACO.

text.p: Teenage striker David Trezeguet has signed his first professional contract with Monaco, the club said on Friday.
Argentine-born Trezeguet, who signed for four years, joins his France youth team mate Thierry Henry on Monaco's books, confirming the club's determination to hang on to their best young prospects.
Henry signed for Monaco last month, ending a tug-of-war with Real Madrid, in contrast to Paris St Germain's teenager Nicolas Anelka who snubbed his club in favour of English premier league Arsenal.
